items.bet_line: Milwaukee Brewers — Game 1 Moneyline @ 1.61 (Brewers -0.5 after 5 innings also fair at F5 prices)
items.text: Milwaukee open the World Series at American Family Field, where their official 2026 home split reads 55-26 (.679) — the strongest home mark feeding this series. Tampa Bay Rays' corresponding road split is a far more modest 43-38 (.531), and October openers rarely forgive that kind of split disadvantage. Take the Milwaukee Brewers to win Game 1 on the Moneyline at 1.61; the first-five-innings line points the same way if you want the shorter route.
